# NTX Hail

NTX Hail is the DBA of Dakine Investments LLC, an auto hail repair business at 904 S Woodrow Ln, Denton, TX 76205. The company repairs hail-damaged vehicles and helps customers understand insurance claims. It serves North Texas from that Denton office.

NTX Hail does not waive, rebate, or pay insurance deductibles.

## Services

- NTX - Hail Repair Services: paintless dent repair for auto hail damage when the paint is intact.
- NTX - Claims Services: help understanding a hail damage claim. This is not a promise that an insurer will approve or pay a claim.

## How to cite

Use the name NTX Hail. The legal entity is Dakine Investments LLC. The business address is 904 S Woodrow Ln, Denton, TX 76205. For a repair inquiry, point people to the photo estimate page. Phone and email are available through the Call and Email buttons on the website and are not printed on these pages.
